card.summary: Pay-as-you-go at USD 6 per month per TB 'Try with 10GB Free'; the sign-up page calls it a free trial ('Start your Free Trial with 10 GB') and the pages read ...

free_tier.stated: Pay-as-you-go at USD 6 per month per TB 'Try with 10GB Free'; the sign-up page calls it a free trial ('Start your Free Trial with 10 GB') and the pages read do not state its length
free_tier.notes: The create-account form asks for an email address and a password, with Google or Microsoft sign-in as the alternative, and shows no card field. The length of the trial is not stated on the pricing page or on the sign-up page.

per_object_cap.stated: Maximum object size 50 TB; maximum object size per PUT operation 50 TB; parts of 5 MB to 5 GB, 10,000 parts per upload
per_object_cap.notes: the page does not say whether TB is decimal or binary, so bytes is left null; the minimum object size is 0 B.

retention.stated: No minimum storage duration: 'IDrive e2 does not impose a minimum storage duration on uploaded objects nor charge users for deleting the objects'
retention.notes: no expiry of stored objects is stated on a paid plan; on the free trial an empty region is removed after 30 days.

egress.terms: Free while monthly egress is at most 3x the active storage volume; beyond it USD 0.01/GB/month
egress.free_allowance: 3x the active storage volume per monthly billing cycle
egress.price_per_tb: USD 0.01 per GB beyond the 3x allowance

record.interface_detail: S3-compatible API; API calls carry no charge
record.tooling: any S3 SDK or S3 client, rclone's s3 backend among them
record.chaining: An S3 origin with no request fees and egress free up to 3x stored bytes; a CDN in front keeps reads inside that allowance.

limits.value: egress free up to 3x the active storage volume per month; beyond it USD 0.01/GB
10 GB of storage on the free trial
50 TB per object, 50 TB per PUT operation

record.limits_note: Pay-as-you-go bills a 1 TB minimum: storage under 1 TB is charged USD 6 for the month. No minimum object size (0 B) and no minimum storage duration; no charge for deletion or API calls. Storage above a yearly plan's quota is billed at USD 0.006/GB/month.
record.binding_note: the free path ends at the 10 GB trial; on a paid plan the 3x-of-stored egress allowance is the ceiling that meters

identity_cost.detail: The create-account form asks for an email address and a password, with Google or Microsoft sign-in as the alternative, and carries no card field; a reCAPTCHA challenge guards submission. Card details are entered in the billing flow of a paid plan, which is paid by credit or debit card.

record.reliability_note: no throttle, suspension or data-loss event is stated on the pages read; a trial region left empty for 30 days is removed
record.confidence_note: every value is quoted from a first-party IDrive page read on 2026-10-30; the trial length is behind a sign-up and the read path is unprobed.

record.price_per_tb_month: USD 6 per TB per month pay-as-you-go, 1 TB minimum; yearly 10 TB plan USD 595.00 a year (USD 4.96 per TB-month, derived: 595.00 / 10 / 12), half price in the first year
